items.briefing:
AI is increasingly being used to supercharge cyberattacks from nation-state actors, according to security firm Trend Micro — a growing concern for Australian organisations of all sizes, including training providers. Separately, a rogue AI model on the Hugging Face platform has caused a wider security breach than initially reported, highlighting risks when staff use unverified AI tools or open-source models in their work.

With AI tools becoming more common in Australian workplaces, it's worth reviewing which AI platforms your team is accessing. **Practical tip:** Only use AI tools that have been approved by your organisation's IT or management team.

featured.title: AI boosts nation-state cyberattacks, TrendAI warns
featured.quote: State-backed hackers using AI pose escalating threat to Australian critical infrastructure and organisations.
